name: Hunan Meihu Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Meihu Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of engine oil pumps, water pumps, transmission pumps, and other pump products for the automotive industry in China and internationally. The company's main products include diesel and gasoline engine oil pumps, electric pumps, modular products, and precision gears.
